required_packet: Traceable incident trigger from source term/field/PAR chain
minimum_local_evidence: EAL/PAR/PAD decision log linked to recovery branch and retraction clock
cannot_be_closed_by: public PAG page or AAR summary
reopen_trigger: field contradiction or old PAD remains active

required_packet: Relocation/shelter/return order authority and scope
minimum_local_evidence: Signed order, map scope, affected population, authority citation, appeal path
reopen_trigger: order map differs from field/PAR data

required_packet: Access-pass and escort controls for temporary reentry
minimum_local_evidence: Pass roster, escort log, dose/time limit, contamination check, rollback rule
reopen_trigger: unescorted entry or dose cap exceeded

required_packet: Worker dosimetry, PPE, turnback, and rotation plan
minimum_local_evidence: Issue/return logs, readings, PPE training, turnback authority, relief staffing

required_packet: Controlled property retrieval for medicine, documents, pets/service animals, assistive devices
minimum_local_evidence: Escort log, time-in-zone, property custody, contamination check, AFN priority list

required_packet: Cleanup characterization grid and data lineage
minimum_local_evidence: Sampling grid, method, lab QA/QC, chain-of-custody, uncertainty statement

required_packet: Cleanup goal, alternatives analysis, and stakeholder decision record
minimum_local_evidence: Decision memo, alternatives matrix, stakeholder record, residual risk disclosure

required_packet: Remediation work package implementation and retest
minimum_local_evidence: Work order, contractor QA, waste generation log, post-cleanup survey, retest results

required_packet: Waste class segregation, staging, labeling, runoff, and security
minimum_local_evidence: Waste inventory, radiation survey, container IDs, staging controls, stormwater checks

required_packet: Waste transport, manifest, receiving-site acceptance, disposal/rejection trace
minimum_local_evidence: DOT/rad transport manifest, route approval, receiver acceptance, rejection handling

required_packet: Accessible temporary/intermediate housing and relocation cashflow
minimum_local_evidence: Unit inventory, accessibility/pet/service-animal slots, lease protections, cash assistance, denials/appeals
reopen_trigger: denial surge or no accessible units

required_packet: School, childcare, IEP, custody, and transport continuity
minimum_local_evidence: Student placement, bus route, IEP/504 continuity, family reunification, absence protections
reopen_trigger: unplaced students or missed IEP supports

required_packet: Small business, farm, worker, and informal livelihood claim path
minimum_local_evidence: Damage/loss intake, documentation help, bridge cash, appeal/legal aid, farm/business continuity

required_packet: Long-term health monitoring registry and follow-up governance
minimum_local_evidence: Registry authority, minimum dataset, consent/public-health basis, dedupe, referral, contact update, retention

required_packet: Medical, relocation, property, wage, and cleanup compensation flow
minimum_local_evidence: Unified intake, eligibility map, documentation help, denials/appeals, language access

required_packet: Fatality management for contaminated remains
minimum_local_evidence: Body survey, PPE/dose control, ID/property chain, morgue/funeral interface, family notification
reopen_trigger: unknown contamination status or family notification defect

required_packet: Return/reentry/relocation advisory update and correction clock
minimum_local_evidence: Message versions, translations, links, hotline script, rumor correction, dated map linkage
reopen_trigger: broken link or wrong zone map

required_packet: Appeal/reopen board for reentry, cleanup, claims, registry, and waste disputes
minimum_local_evidence: Docket, decision criteria, response SLA, counterevidence path, independent review

required_packet: Language access, disability access, civil-rights, and no-wrong-door recovery path
minimum_local_evidence: Translated materials, interpreters, disability accommodation logs, denial monitoring

required_packet: Stakeholder participation and trust-repair record for cleanup/return decisions
minimum_local_evidence: Meeting records, comment responses, tribal/local representation, dissent/resolution log

required_packet: Property/building/vehicle decontamination and release certificates
minimum_local_evidence: Pre/post survey, method, release criterion, owner notice, dispute process

required_packet: Cleanup runoff, stormwater, wastewater, and secondary contamination control
minimum_local_evidence: Erosion/runoff plan, water sampling, waste-water disposition, discharge/restriction decision

required_packet: Pets/service animals, livestock, carcass, feed, and farm-property interface
minimum_local_evidence: Animal sheltering, veterinary survey, carcass/waste plan, producer claims link

required_packet: No-average-away public claim gate for late-phase recovery
minimum_local_evidence: Claim board minutes, blocker check, source independence check, redaction review
reopen_trigger: any open P0 or public-source closure leak
